fixtures.subject: animal-cat

derived_from.prompt: A clear illustration of a cat sitting, three-quarter view. Show these structures clearly and in correct relation to each other: head, ears, eyes, body, front legs, tail. Draw it as a pen-and-ink illustration for an e-ink notebook: confident black outlines on plain white paper, clear silhouettes, and only light, sparse hatching for form; no smooth gradients, airbrushing or dense texture. Prefer fewer, deliberate lines that stay legible when redrawn with a pen at notebook size. Keep one consistent viewpoint: every part appears as it would in that view, and in a cross-section cut structures show their cut profile. Mostly black ink on white: add flat color only where the subject naturally has it or where a standard textbook color convention exists, never for decoration or to make parts arbitrarily different, and leave most areas white. No text, letters, numbers, labels, leader lines, arrows, borders or watermarks.

fixtures.processing: downscaled to a 768 px longest edge with macOS sips (Lanczos), otherwise unmodified
